HOW TO ADD GAMES (Saturn core, akoaysigod.Saturn)
==================================================

Each game needs two things on the SD card:

  1. Its folder, the .cue and its .bin files, in this folder:   Assets/saturn/common/MyGame/
  2. Its entry, the game you pick in the menu:                  Assets/saturn/akoaysigod.Saturn/MyGame.json

The core reads the .cue itself. Both kinds of rip work: one .bin per track (Redump) or a
single .bin (chdman extractcd, binmerge). Up to 25 .bin files per game.

The BIOS goes in this folder too, named boot.rom (512 KB, not included).


By hand
-------
  1. Copy the game's folder into this folder, as in step 1 above.

  2. Make a text file Assets/saturn/akoaysigod.Saturn/MyGame.json:

       {
           "instance": {
               "magic": "APF_VER_1",
               "data_path": "MyGame/",
               "data_slots": [
                   { "id": 14, "filename": "MyGame.cue" },
                   { "id": 16, "filename": "MyGame (Track 01).bin" },
                   { "id": 17, "filename": "MyGame (Track 02).bin" }
               ]
           }
       }

     - "data_path": the game's folder name here in Assets/saturn/common/, ending with a /.
     - id 14: the .cue.
     - ids 16, 17, 18, ...: the .bin files in the order the .cue lists them (its FILE
       lines), up to id 40.
     - "filename": exactly as the file is named.
     - Every line in the list except the last ends with a comma.

  3. Pick "MyGame" in the core's menu.

On a computer with the core's source, tools/cue2instance.py MyGame.cue writes the .json.


Pocket Sync or Pupdate
----------------------
The core folder has an instance-packager.json, so these SD card updaters can write the
.json files ("Instance JSONs" in Pocket Sync, the instance JSON option in Pupdate). Not
tried with this core yet: check that a written .json has the .cue as id 14 and the .bin
files from id 16 in the .cue's order.


Notes
-----
  - The .json's name is the name in the menu and the name of the game's save files
    (in Saves/saturn/akoaysigod.Saturn/). Renaming the .json starts the game with empty
    backup RAM.
  - Region: the core can't read a disc's region on the Pocket and starts as USA. For a
    Japanese or European game, set Core Settings > Region, then choose Reset.
  - Games that need a RAM cartridge (1 MB or 4 MB): set Core Settings > Cartridge, then
    choose Reset. "Backup RAM" gives the save cartridge, saved with the game.
  - Not supported: CHD (convert it: chdman extractcd -i MyGame.chd -o MyGame.cue), ISO
    (MODE1/2048) tracks, WAVE / MP3 / OGG audio files, .ccd / .mds images.
  - Multi-disc games: one folder per disc. Each disc is its own entry with its own saves;
    the core can't swap discs.
  - "BIOS (no disc)" in the menu boots the BIOS (CD player and system settings) without a
    game.
